column1:
2029-00-104-0001
Expenditure on
Revenue
Administration
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Reduction in provision of
₹25.00 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹20.00 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹45.00 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts for
medical reimbursement of
posted staff in Regional
offices of Revenue and
Land Reform Department
in financial year 2023-24.
Decrease was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
